title.zh: 将巴丹省迪纳卢皮汉市镇迪纳卢皮汉区医院的名称变更为Jose C. Payumo，Jr.，纪念医院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Dinalupihan District Hospital in the Municipality of Dinalupihan, Province of Bataan, To Jose C. Payumo, Jr., Memorial Hospital
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Dinalupihan District Hospital in the Municipality of Dinalupihan, Province of Bataan, To Jose C. Payumo, Jr., Memorial Hospital
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Bệnh viện huyện Dinalupihan tại Thị trấn Dinalupihan, Tỉnh Bataan thành Bệnh viện tưởng niệm Jose C. Payumo, Jr.,
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Dinalupihan ในเทศบาล Dinalupihan, จังหวัด Bataan เป็นโรงพยาบาลอนุสรณ์ Jose C. Payumo, Jr.,
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Rumah Sakit Kabupaten Dinalupihan di Kotamadya Dinalupihan, Provinsi Bataan menjadi Rumah Sakit Peringatan Jose C. Payumo, Jr.,
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Hospital Daerah Dinalupihan di Perbandaran Dinalupihan, Wilayah Bataan menjadi Hospital Peringatan Jose C. Payumo, Jr.,

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7404_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Dinalupihan District Hospital in the Municipality of Dinalupihan, Province of Bataan, is hereby changed to Jose C. Payumo, Jr., Memorial Hospital.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
